limits: Les trois événements environnementaux sont reliés à leurs actions et au décodage natif sous services physiques fournis. Les quatre cas couvrent six voix, deux refus probabilistes et deux horloges déclarées ; ils ne qualifient pas tous les tirages, émetteurs de jeu, ordres multi-événements, streaming, boucles, concurrence ou backend Rust complet. Original code runs in isolated Unicorn memory. OS heap/pools,TLS,locks,clock,COM and thread/event transport are supplied; no historical game process or audio hardware.
The first3-frame run stops before a nonzero device signal and before shutdown; it is retained as failed, not counted as successful retirement.

Four collector parent hints were reversed. Authoritative pairs use the native decoder owner field+12 and parent decoder field+8, verified against native code bytes. Old hints and unused global lifetime snapshots are retained, not promoted as evidence. The epoch0 probe fixes only the passive parent attribution.

Two current core tests compare selection/order/probability. Device mixing and physical playback are not provided by these Rust tests. Native probability rejection may still return playing_id1 without a voice.
Five functions are freshly analyzed by REA; B05050 weighted choice and B06B10 deferred execution are static here, not claimed executed by these unweighted immediate profiles.
